description: Microsoft long-form multi-speaker TTS model for expressive conversational audio such as podcasts, supporting up to 90 minutes of speech with as many as four speakers.

request.name: voice_samples
request.description: Comma-separated speaker reference WAV paths for up to four multi-speaker prompts; reference audio is trimmed to 10 seconds on CPU/Vulkan/Metal and 30 seconds on CUDA.

request.name: max_tokens
request.description: Maximum decoder generation tokens; default 0 leaves generation capped by model context and max_length_times.

request.name: num_inference_steps
request.description: Diffusion inference steps; defaults to model config, usually 10.

request.name: max_length_times
request.description: Maximum decoder generation steps as a positive multiplier of prompt token steps; default 2.0.

request.name: do_sample
request.description: Sample constrained speech-control tokens instead of greedy selection; default false.

request.name: temperature
request.description: Constrained-token sampling temperature; must be positive when sampling, default 1.0.

request.name: top_k
request.description: Top-k filter for constrained-token sampling; 0 disables top-k filtering, default 50.

request.name: top_p
request.description: Nucleus filter for constrained-token sampling; must be in (0, 1], default 1.0.

request.name: seed
request.description: Random seed for prompt acoustic sampling, diffusion noise, and optional constrained-token sampling; default 1234.

request.name: prompt_noise_path
request.description: F32 prompt acoustic noise file for deterministic reference-voice acoustic latent replay.

request.name: diffusion_noise_path
request.description: F32 initial diffusion noise file for deterministic generated-speech diffusion replay.

session.name: weight_type
session.description: Tokenizer, connector, decoder, and diffusion-head weight storage type; default native.

session.name: tokenizer_weight_type
session.description: Audio tokenizer weight storage type; defaults to weight_type when set, otherwise native.

session.name: connector_weight_type
session.description: Acoustic and semantic connector weight storage type; defaults to weight_type when set, otherwise native.

session.name: decoder_weight_type
session.description: Language decoder weight storage type; defaults to weight_type when set, otherwise native.

session.name: diffusion_head_weight_type
session.description: Diffusion prediction head weight storage type; defaults to weight_type when set, otherwise native.

load.name: lora_path
load.description: Fine-tune adapter dir (LM LoRA + diffusion head + acoustic/semantic connectors) merged at load time.

load.name: lora_scale
load.description: LoRA merge scale override; defaults to lora_alpha / r.
